exposure: maternal gestational diabetes treatment type (diet, oral hypoglycemic agents, insulin)
cohort: 350 newborns born at or after 24 weeks gestation to mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in a tertiary care hospital in Pakistan
finding: Infants of diabetic mothers (IDMs) whose mothers were treated with insulin had significantly higher rates of certain complications compared to those whose mothers were managed with diet control or oral hypoglycemic agents.
